description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Mampe, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District  - Cad. Map No. 521202
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, extents, and ownership details) in the Mampe area. The content focuses entirely on land registration, title determinations, and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4). There is no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative content.
